method: Lexical scan of all src TS/TSX/CSS, including candidates in non-presentation TS. Comments suppressed. No CSS cascade, runtime occurrence, physical-pixel or reachability inference. text-[var(...)] includes color candidates: classify via human inventory. Counts are source mentions, not defects.
